protocol.research: exactly manifest.technologyClosure, nothing else; inserter capacity bonus zero
protocol.feed: belts: items put on the entrance belt (generous: both lanes kept full; throttled: a credit of perMinute/3600 per tick, capped at 8, one item per credit on alternating lanes); pipes: fluid put into one outside pipe (generous: kept full; throttled: perMinute/3600 per tick plus the refused carry, capped at one second)
protocol.draw: belt exits: everything on the exit tile removed every four ticks, or a per-minute credit; pipe exits: fluid removed from one outside pipe every tick (all, or perMinute/3600 plus the unmet carry, capped at one second)

footprint.includes: all entities, panels, substation, belts and the acid pipe; external supply excluded
